> Each measured change produced a new physical fact: pressure became burning,
> the contracting ring became an open tremor, and cool air reached skin that had

Do not jump directly to "ruined" or "gaping." Describe stages, position,
muscular resistance, pauses, communication, visible change, and aftermath.

or permanent ownership.
